biomarkers.name: ER, PR
biomarkers.clinical_use: ER testing is recommended to guide endocrine therapy; tamoxifen (and in postmenopausal patients, an aromatase inhibitor in selected settings) reduces ipsilateral and contralateral breast events

biomarkers.name: HER2
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not routinely recommended for clinical testing in pure DCIS; currently does not routinely change standard management

biomarkers.name: Oncotype DX DCIS score
biomarkers.clinical_use: Provides prognostic information for local recurrence risk after breast-conserving surgery in selected patients; not routinely recommended in current standard practice to guide radiotherapy decisions

biomarkers.name: Grade (nuclear, architectural, comedonecrosis)
biomarkers.clinical_use: High nuclear grade and comedonecrosis are associated with higher local recurrence risk and are linked to greater risk of concurrent or subsequent invasive carcinoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Malignant epithelial cells confined within basement membrane of ducts and lobules

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: TIL density variable; higher in high-grade / comedo DCIS
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Periductal fibrosis; minimal desmoplasia (myoepithelial layer intact)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Luminal epithelial cells of TDLU with malignant transformation confined by intact myoepithelial-basement membrane barrier
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Luminal differentiation preserved with variable nuclear grade; intact myoepithelial layer (calponin+, p63+, SMMHC+) defines in situ status
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Progression to invasive breast cancer requires disruption of the myoepithelial cell layer and basement membrane; this is a complex tumor-microenvironment and epithelial progression process rather than being reducible to myoepithelial loss alone
